articles.summary: DANBURY, Conn., Aug. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - FuelCell Energy , Inc. (Nasdaq: FCEL) - announced the upcoming release of its third quarter 2026 results prior to the stock market open on Wednesday, September 2, 2026. FuelCell Energy management will subsequently host a conference call beginning at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time the same day to discuss the results and provide a business update. Participants can access the live call via webcast on the company website or by telephone as follows: The live webcast of this call and supporting slide presentation will be available at www.fuelcellenergy.com . To listen to the call, select ‘Investors’ on the home page, proceed to the ‘Events Presentations’ page and then click on the ‘Webcast’ link under the September 2 nd earnings call event listed.
